annotation_method: Single assessor, source-grounded, retrieval-blind annotations frozen before held-out retrieval. No independent human review. Minimal supporting spans, not exhaustive relevance judgments. Positive explicit/semantic pairs test the same new facts with different wording; not independent fact samples. This is question holdout on the same products and documents, not a product/source holdout.
